Set HIGHLEVEL_MODE=provider only in an approved test or isolated_staging runtime first.
Set HIGHLEVEL_SYNC_ENABLED=true only after workflow IDs and custom field IDs are recorded.

Run manual-contact-mapping.ts in dry-run before any local link apply.
